description: Submits a request to retest a page whose existing report is considered obsolete. Set reviewImmediately to true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved (testing then typically takes 2 to 4 minutes); set it to false to queue the request for review by management, which typically takes 1 hour to 1 day. The reportID must belong to the page’s latest report and the reason is what the reviewer evaluates. A refusal, such as a superseded report, a duplicate request, or a full queue, is reported in the disposition. Returns a confirmation with disposition details, including, on immediate approval, a report identifier and a question about whether to wait for completion with the awaitTest tool.

reason.description: 20- to 100-character justification evaluated by the reviewer selected by reviewImmediately

reportID.description: Identifier of the latest report about the page, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z); a superseded identifier is rejected

reviewImmediately.description: true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved; false or omitted to queue the request for review by management

name: requestRetest

page identifier.description: Identifier of the page, or null if the page does not exist yet.

site identifier.description: Identifier of the site, or null if the site does not exist yet.

date and time.description: UTC date and time when the response was generated, in ISO 8601 format.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of this response (timestamp and random suffix).

this request.description: URL of the equivalent web UI page for this request.

URL.description: URL of the Kilotest MCP server.

description.description: Explanation of what Kilotest does and how to use its tools.

required: web users can obtain similar functionalities at
reason why the page should be retested

possible duplicates.description: Tested pages that may be the requested page. If one is, its latest report can be used at once.

identifier of the latest report.description: Identifier of the latest report about the page (example: 260503T0432-x9z).

name.description: Name of the page, distinguishing it from the other pages of its site.

sites.description: The sites that the page belongs to (currently always one).

anyOf.description: Identifier of the report, to pass to listIssues once the report is ready (example: 260503T0432-x9z).

similar sites.description: Existing sites that may be the requested site. If one is, a test of a page of it can be requested with requestNewTest by giving its identifier as siteID.

whether your request was referred to man.description: true if immediate review was requested but the request was referred to management review because of possible duplicates or similar sites.

required: how you can check for completion

reason.description: 20- to 100-character justification evaluated by the reviewer selected by reviewImmediately

reviewImmediately.description: true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved; false or omitted to queue the request for review by management

required: URLs of similar requests for web users
